newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips off lows but soft, Nasdaq gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips off lows but soft, Nasdaq gains.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks were soft but off early lows on Monday after Friday's triple witcing expiration of futures and options. The Nasdaq composite, however, climbed steadily to positive ground.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was down 32.57 points at 7763.94 while the Nasdaq composite was up 1.63 points at 1448.73.
"In general, it is normal to have a bit of downdraft after triple witching," Ron Doran, director of institutional trading at C.L. King and Associates, said.
Takeover announcements in the energy and technology sectors were generating market activity, traders said.
Shares of Tandem Computers Inc rose 6-1/4 at 21-1/4 after Compaq Computer Corp said it agreed to acquire the company in a stock swap worth about $3 billion.
Pennzoil Co stock was up 19-1/4 at 78-7/8 following news that Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said it renewed its attempt to acquire the company.
Union Pacific Resources stock was down 3/4 at 25-5/8.
Tobacco stocks held their ground in brisk trade after a proposed landmark settlement between the industry and U.S. states, traders said.
